newsitem.title: USA: US FERC orders audit of Natural on Amoco complaint.
newsitem.headline: US FERC orders audit of Natural on Amoco complaint.

text.p: The U.S. Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Tuesday ordered its staff to audit the allocation of natural gas capacity by Natural Gas Pipeline Company of America, a subsidiary of Occidental Petroleum Corp.
The FERC ordered the audit on a complaint from Amoco Corp that Natural showed favoritism toward a Natural affiliate, MidCon Gas Services Corp, a complaint Natural denied.
The commission staff will audit Natural's records, procedures and practices back to January 1, 1995, focusing on capacity allocation, requests for service and contracting for capacity.
Results are to be made public and interested parties will have a chance to comment. FERC then will decide what action, if any, is warranted.
The commission also granted several parties permission to intervene, despite objections from Natural.
